subject: Floating Debris - East Coast - Bay Bulls
text:
Floating Debris - East Coast - Bay Bulls
Floating debris reported in the vicinity of Bay Bulls harbour at 291529 UTC Jul 2026. A wharf has broken loose from the southern shoreline and is now located in the vicinity of 47 18.924N 052 48.788W. A section of the wharf is visible above the water and mariners must navigate around it. 
Caution.
